content:
OpenSearch Ingestion supports end-to-end acknowledgement to ensure data durability. When a
pipeline reads snapshots or streams, it dynamically creates partitions for parallel processing. The
pipeline marks a partition as complete when it receives an acknowledgement after ingesting all
records in the OpenSearch domain or collection.
If you want to ingest into an OpenSearch Serverless search collection, you can generate a
document ID in the pipeline. If you want to ingest into an OpenSearch Serverless time series
collection, note that the pipeline doesn't generate a document ID.
An OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline also maps incoming event actions into corresponding bulk
indexing actions to help ingest documents. This keeps data consistent, so that every data change in
DynamoDB is reconciled with the corresponding document changes in OpenSearch.

hierarchy.parent: Using an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline with Amazon DynamoDB
